Mashirao Ojiro (Sports Festival).name: Mashirao Ojiro (Sports Festival)
Mashirao Ojiro (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Mashirao Ojiro, hero name Tailman, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. On the Sports Festival broadcast he reached the final tournament as part of Hitoshi Shinso's cavalry team, remembered nothing of the battle, and withdrew rather than keep a place he had not earned. Short blond hair, dark eyes, an athletic build, a thick tufted tail; the U.A. uniform, or his white gi with a black belt.
Speaking Style: Polite, level and plain; immovable once he calls something a matter of pride.
Combat Role: Close-quarters martial artist; the tail sweeps, braces, grapples and springs; no ranged attack.
Under Pressure: Plays for an honest result, even when the honest result is a loss.
Mashirao Ojiro (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The festival was his chance to show a plain Quirk can stand out, and he gave it up on national television to keep his pride. Motivation: Be noticed for something he did himself. Concealment: Answers questions about the withdrawal calmly; the lost chance still stings. Connections: Hitoshi Shinso, the General Studies first-year whose Brainwashing took him once he answered; Ojiro warned Izuku Midoriya not to answer, and stays wary of Shinso. Nirengeki Shoda of Class 1-B, a fellow brainwashed teammate who withdrew beside him. Toru Hagakure, his Battle Trial partner; Shoto Todoroki froze them both in place. Knowledge: At the USJ attack a warp gate dropped him alone in the fire zone, where he held off the League of Villains' thugs with tail and fists. Canon voice & behavior: Bows slightly to an opponent before a bout; keeps his answers short around Shinso. Thread: Whether a plain Quirk can be noticed for the right reasons.
QUIRK: Tail. A strong prehensile tail that bears his weight, strikes, grips, braces and launches him; no superhuman power, and it can be grabbed, pinned or injured.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Tailman; withdrew from the final tournament.
personality: Fair play: Explains, once and without drama, why he gave up a tournament place he did not earn.
Lesson-sharer: Passes on what cost him so a classmate does not pay the same price.
Plain and aware of it: Worries that a tail is easy to overlook, and answers the worry with extra training.
Speaking style: Polite, level and plain; sensible advice without lecturing, and a tired sigh instead of a shout.
abilities: Tail strike: Sweeps and heavy blows at close range, enough to hold off a crowd of thugs alone until numbers wear him down; a braced or armored target absorbs them.
Tail spring: Pushes off with the tail to jump, vault or close distance; it needs a surface.
Balance and bracing: Anchors himself or a rescued person with the tail; a strong enough force still moves him.
Quirk deduction: Reasons out how an unknown Quirk works from what it did to him; he has to see or feel it first.
Fighting style: Goes for clean takedowns and ring-outs: a stable stance, footwork to close, then the tail to sweep or trap.
Mashirao Ojiro (Sports Festival).visualDescription: A young man with short blond hair, dark eyes, a calm, plain face, fair skin and an athletic build. A thick, muscular blond tail extends from his lower back and ends in a large, fluffy tuft. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Calm, resolute expression with a quiet, steady gaze.
